ios.desc:
Transform your photos into epic manga and comic adventures! MangaMe turns any photo into professional manga art, letting you become the creator of your own visual stories.

# Turn Photos Into Manga Magic:
Simply upload any photo and watch as advanced AI transforms it into stunning manga art. Add your own story descriptions to create authentic manga panels that capture the emotion and excitement of your real experiences.

# Choose Your Perfect Art Style

Shonen Jump: Dynamic action scenes for adventures and achievements
Shojo: Elegant romantic panels for relationships and emotional moments
Gekiga: Cinematic realism for meaningful life events
Clamp: Sophisticated designs for complex personal stories
Tezuka: Classic expressive cartoon style for joyful memories
Seinen: Detailed mature art for deeper life narratives

# Build Your Personal Manga Series
Create an ongoing visual diary where every day becomes a new chapter. Document coffee dates, family gatherings, travel adventures, quiet reflections, and milestone moments. Watch your life unfold like your favorite manga series with a continuous timeline of beautiful illustrated memories.

Share Your Story!
Export high-quality manga chapters perfect for Instagram, TikTok, and social media. Create collaborative chapters with friends and family members. Build shared memory books that bring people together through visual storytelling.

No Drawing Skills Required

Professional manga creation has never been more accessible. Our AI handles the complex artistic transformation while you focus on capturing and describing your meaningful moments. Start creating publication-quality manga in seconds.

# Perfect For:
- Social media content creators seeking unique visual posts
- Families wanting to document memories in an artistic format
- Travel enthusiasts creating visual journey documentation
- Long-distance friends and couples sharing daily life creatively
- Anyone wanting to express life experiences through manga art
- Memory preservation with an entertaining creative twist

# Key Features:

- Instant photo-to-manga transformation with advanced AI
- Six distinct professional manga art styles
- Collaborative chapter creation with others
- Personal timeline to revisit your manga journey
- High-resolution exports for social sharing
- Intuitive interface requiring no artistic experience
- Permanent cloud storage for your manga collection
- Daily chapter system for ongoing storytelling

show_hn.title: Show HN: I made an app that turns your life memories into Manga

quotes.text:
I enjoy reading manga and journaling. Recently, I started wondering what would happen if I combined the two... I wanted a different way to document moments that happen in my life in a format that’s almost just as personal as writing, but also easy to share with friends.

That’s how the idea to turn life memories into manga came about. With MangaMe, you can take moments from your life, anything from funny stories to the most mundane everyday activities, and turn them into a manga page for you to keep or share.

The hardest part has been getting the AI to keep characters looking the same across different panels as I only require one selfie for this, and sometimes the text in speech bubbles still gets jumbled, but I think it's at a point that I wanted to share and collect feedback.

It’s a hard paywall since I’m using GPT-4 image for the image generation, but I currently have a promo going on now for 3 free generation credits. Would love for you to check it out and let me know what you think, or if you run into any weirdness.

Thanks!

iOS App: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6746081532

Landing Page: https://www.manga-me.me/
